text:
Echo State Networks (ESNs) are a type of recurrent neural network used for processing time-series data. They consist of a large, fixed-size, randomly connected hidden layer called a reservoir, which projects the input data into a higher-dimensional space. The weights of the reservoir are typically fixed and not trained, making the training process simpler. Only the output weights are adjusted to fit the desired output. Reservoir computing is a broader framework that includes ESNs and other similar architectures.
